meta.name: Observer clock
meta.description: Two observers watch each other, so each pulse triggers the other: a free-running fast clock. The dust on the east flickers with every pulse; the lamp on the west stays lit, because the pulses come too fast for a lamp to go dark (checked in game). Placing the second observer starts it, so /function builds a running clock; /structure load may place it stopped (give it a block update to start).

annotations.text: Looks east at its partner; pulses out of its back (west).
Looks west at its partner; pulses out of its back (east).
